qualification: Only accounting and fidelity decide reference usability; all other measurements are descriptive.
population: Surviving committed seats, grouped by assigned starting line; eliminated seats are not imputed as zero.
commit_definition: Quilboar: first native commit condition; other fixed line seats are assigned from R1, not an observed player decision.
counting: Pre-start active-board Attack+Health; hand, sky and Belly reserves excluded. Post-start values reported separately.

bootstrap.method: 95% percentile whole-lobby seed bootstrap, retaining eliminated empty clusters

paper.counting: Attack plus Health of the recruit board before combat; Quilboar needs no body-count conversion.
paper.arrivals: Paper arrivals are scripted, not shopped; Phase 1 lacks the paper's early Roadboar Gems.

growth_r8_r14.qualification: Descriptive survivor-population growth, not within-player compounding; no pass/fail bar.
